worked_solution:
When a particle (or object) moves with constant velocity $u,$ the position vector at time $t$ is given by the equation

$$
r={r}_{0}+ut,
$$

where ${r}_{0}$ is the initial position vector.

In this case,

$$
{r}_{0}=6i+4j,\,u=-2i-1j.
$$

Therefore, the position vector of the bird after $t=3\,\text{s}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & ={r}_{0}+ut \\  & =(6i+4j)+(-2i-1j)(3) \\  & =6i+4j-6i-3j \\  & =(\,0\,i+1\,j)\,\text{yd}.\end{aligned}
$$
